purpose: Reviewed native anchors for the 23 OoT Wallmaster logic edges of OoTMM v32.3 (unit M1-12): one entry per edge with the native region the capture is evaluated in, the pinned condition in native helpers, the actor-room evidence and a status. tools/ootmm/export_oot_wallmaster_edges.py re-checks every claim against the pinned edge fixture, these sources and, locally, the extracted OoT archive.
principle: Prefer a native anchor plus the translated pinned condition. Atoms beyond the pinned edge condition are added only where the native anchor region contains places from which the capture is physically impossible without them (ingressAtoms, portAtoms). A combo-only node or event is proposed only where that cannot express the pinned source (a persistent event). The anchor's own native ingress is the port's dungeon logic and is compared, not rewritten.

statuses.false: the pinned condition is false in the port (absent settings); no edge

relations.equal: the native anchor is entered behind the same gates as the pinned source area
relations.native-stronger: native needs more to enter the anchor; logic stays conservative
relations.native-weaker: native needs less; the entry says why that is the port's own sound rule
relations.native-rule: the same fight or puzzle under the port's own kill or item rule
relations.equal-with-ingress-atom: equal once the condition carries the listed ingress atoms
relations.provisional: the anchor waits for actor-position evidence (openBlockers)

actorFacts.fact: Wallmaster params: low byte is the type (0 timer, 1 proximity, 2 switch flag, 3 ShadowTag), high byte the switch flag that spawns a type-2 Wallmaster.
A proximity Wallmaster drops on Link once he is within 200 units of its home position in XZ, at any height; a switch-flag Wallmaster drops as soon as its flag is set.
A switch-flag Wallmaster is removed at spawn while its flag is set. Flags 0x20-0x37 are temporary and kept until the scene is left; 0x38-0x3F are cleared on every room change.
The pinned runtime picks the source row from the actor's own room (this->room), not the current room.
Chest actors keep their treasure flag in params & 0x1F; native Location::Chest rows carry the same full params, so a chest in an actor list names one native check and one pinned pool row.
Pinned xflag checks (pots, crates, hearts, icicles) are keyed by (actor room << 8) | actor index, so a pinned pool id names the room of the area that lists it.
A light switch keeps its switch flag in (params >> 8) & 0x3F and its type in (params >> 4) & 3; type 3 (BURN) is a fake sun that sets its flag when lit and disappears.

The Forest Temple hallway object Bg_Mori_Hineri takes its hall from params & 0x8000 (0: the NW hall, 2: the NE hall); the NW hall spawns the Boss Key chest with params 0x27EE (10222), native RC_FOREST_TEMPLE_BOSS_KEY_CHEST.

archive.source: The user's own extracted OoT archive (oot.o2r, non-MQ resources scenes/nonmq/<scene>_scene/<scene>_room_<n>), read-only with SoH's binary scene-command layout. Never a ROM file. No MQ archive exists locally or on the AVD (C17).
